name: Sign-up grid (shifts or jobs by time, each needs n people)
use_when: jobs or shifts at set hours that each take a crew: move-in, booth shifts, volunteer slots, setup and cleanup
'signup sheet', 'volunteer signups', 'booth shifts', 'can anyone help carry'
anyone can take several, and the gaps stay visible
dont_use_when: named seats or beds where each person gets exactly one (use slots)
things to bring, with no times (use claims)
finding a time that works for everyone (use overlap)
guarantees: a row never has more people than it needs; a person is on a row once
people sign up for as many rows as they like, up to the per-person cap when one is set
a row is marked full exactly when its last spot is taken; rows still short are counted at the top
a leaver comes off every row and those rows open up; a late joiner can take any open spot

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Move-in day' or 'Club fair booth'

label.description: The job or shift, e.g. 'Couch and bed frames'

perPerson.description: Most rows one person can take, 0 for no limit

examples.title: Climbing club booth at the activities fair
